comments.author: OwoMeji
comments.body:
I REALLY like the transition.

I would approach it differently. I would start with the fully rendered city at rest. The faster I move/more speed I attain,  I would remove color, building height, vector lines, and so on until just the track and the outline of it were visible at the maximum speed of my bike. Making like a tunnel vision effect. If I stopped or crashed the fully rendered world comes in the same way it dissipates. Slowing down from high speed to corner would have a minimal effect or wouldn’t re-render the city within a certain threshold of speed/time since sometimes you have to slow down for corners/turns. What do you think?
